evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep: 'we just wanted to ask a few questions to get you on white track this would take within the next five to ten minutes of your time so I can build an accurate quote for you.' — time-boxed but rushes past; no clear wait for confirmation before moving to next topic.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep jumps directly to 'Let's talk about your move. Do you have any biggest concerns...' but this is phrased as probing, not as a genuine agenda-setting question before logistics start.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer did not raise concerns; she described furniture and location facts only.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details: Rep asks: property type (apartment), floor (first floor, two-story complex), number of rooms (one bedroom, no additional rooms), walking distance (assumes parking nearby, customer estimates 'a minute walk'), special considerations (service elevator, wide hallway, no access issues). All seven major items covered or confirmed.
evidence_quotes.packing_services: Rep asks: 'Do we need help in packing? This is from point A to point B is that correct?' Customer replies 'No, no we do not.'
evidence_quotes.box_count: Not asked. Rep does not ask about typical box count for this size move or overflow/special items.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides: 'A typical one bedroom apartment would normally take two movers. That's between two and a half to three and a half hours... The estimated cost is from $525.35 to $735.' Personalizes to customer's move (first floor pickup, 32 minutes away, second floor with elevators, 2 movers). Full anchor and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep states: '$105 per hour per mover... everything is already included on the hourly rate, that is the gas, the trucks, the taxes and insurance' and 'the time will only start as soon as we get on site... minimum of two and a half hours... prorated into fifteen minute increments.' Mentions no hidden fees. Both transparency and commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_silence: Not asked. After providing estimate, rep moves directly to 'I just wanted to let you know that a typical one bedroom apartment...' without asking if the price feels fair or pausing for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Rep states: 'We have on time guarantee we value your time. So if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' Discount terms fully delivered.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Rep states: 'We have no worry damage coverage included on the rate weight that you're paying us, we will provide up to 2000 dollars per move that is to repair, replace and reimburse for your items.' Covers $2,000 and 'included on the rate' (built in, not add-on). Does not explicitly state 'no deductible' or 'no fine print' framing — partial delivery.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' and does not confirm whether the two promises address the customer's concerns (no concerns were raised, so this is technically correct but incomplete as a loop-close).
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any genuine final-concerns variant.
evidence_quotes.catch_all: Not asked. Rep does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Not asked directly. Rep says 'Either, or even if you schedule it online, you would still call you so you can just respond in the email call us or text us if you wanted to push forward so we can reserve the movers...' — this is an out: 'schedule online' or 'call back later,' not a plain 'Would you like our help with your move?' Customer never commits; she says 'I will, I don't want to go ahead and schedule it right now because I have to talk to my daughter first.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock: Rep states: 'no deposit required. No recent securing your spot.' Rate lock (no deposit) mentioned.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (October 18th Sunday 2026), time window (8:30 AM to 9:00 AM), crew size (2 movers). Missing: phone number reconfirmed at close, arrival address reconfirmed, notes left about concerns. Customer defers decision pending daughter approval; booking not finalized.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently — property type, floors, rooms, walking distances, special considerations, and item inventory were all covered and confirmed, providing a solid foundation for the estimate.
coaching_note: Rep must ask 'Their Agenda' (Section 2) before moving into probing, then ask 'Does that feel fair?' after the estimate (Section 4) and hold silence; these two gaps cost significant points and weaken discovery and pricing confidence.
